verdicts.reason: A is a jumbled patchwork: the headline is split across two big lines that fight the tall italic subtitle column; the RSVP button is shrunk to pill size and lumped in with the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS tags, so the CTA gets lost; the date block, URL and legal text float as separate pieces; and the SOLSTICE logo text is clipped by a dot ('SOLST CE'). B has a sensible three-column banner, a clear centred headline, grouped tags and a prominent RSVP button on the right, but the subtitle leaves an orphaned 'of the year' line, the left date block crowds the edge, and the missing-asset placeholder box is visible next to the CTA.
